# UniCoach

> UniCoach is a career counselling and study abroad guidance company based in Panipat, Haryana, India. It helps Indian students choose a career first, then the right course, country and university, and guides them on applications, scholarships, education loans and student visas. The first consultation is free, online or at the Panipat office. It also publishes free country guides, exam guides and online tools for Indian students planning to study abroad.

Key facts:
- Website: https://www.unicoach.com
- Audience: Indian students planning bachelor's, master's or PhD study abroad
- Destinations covered: USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, France, Italy and New Zealand
- Services: career counselling, study abroad counselling, university shortlisting, SOP and LOR help, scholarship guidance, education loan guidance, student visa guidance, English test guidance (IELTS, PTE, Duolingo)
- First consultation: free (online or at the Panipat office): https://www.unicoach.com/book-consultation
- Serves students from Panipat, Karnal, Sonipat, Kurukshetra, Jind and Delhi in person, and students across India online
- Office: 1st Floor, Gali No. 4, Sahil Colony, Jattal Road, Sondhapur Village, Panipat, Haryana 132105, India
- Contact: info@unicoach.in, +91 97999 94524 (Mon to Sat, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST)

## Haryana: district guides

Local guides for students in Haryana. Each one lists the nearest IELTS and PTE test centre, the passport office, where to give visa biometrics, which courses suit students from that district, and how to check a consultant under the Haryana Registration and Regulation of Travel Agents Act, 2025 (rules approved 3 November 2026).

## Study abroad guides

Full guides written for Indian students. Each one answers the question directly at the top, uses tables for the numbers, and cites the official source.

### Visa rule changes
- [Australia student visa changes, October 2026](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/australia-student-visa-changes-october-2026): from 2 October 2026 most student visa holders cannot bring a spouse or children
- [US F-1 visa new rules 2026](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/us-f1-visa-new-rules-2026): from 15 September 2026 F-1 students get a fixed admission period instead of duration of status
- [UK Graduate Route cut to 18 months](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/uk-graduate-route-18-months): from 1 January 2027 the Graduate Route drops from 2 years to 18 months
- [Canada study permit guide 2026](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/canada-student-visa-study-permit-guide-2026): SDS has ended, proof of funds is CAD 22,895, PAL rules and PGWP eligibility

### Country guides
- [Study in New Zealand for Indian students](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/study-in-new-zealand-for-indian-students): NZD 20,000 funds rule, the 25-hour work limit, and the new post-study work visas that took effect on 16 November 2026

### Cost, loans and scholarships
- [Cost of studying abroad for Indian students](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/cost-of-studying-abroad-for-indian-students): country-by-country tuition, living costs and the money a visa makes you prove
- [Education loan for study abroad without collateral](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/education-loan-for-study-abroad-without-collateral): which lenders give unsecured loans, the limits, and what they actually check
- [How to study abroad for free](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/how-to-study-abroad-for-free): tuition-free countries and fully funded scholarships, with the ones that have closed marked as closed

### Exams
- [IELTS score required to study abroad](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/ielts-score-required-to-study-abroad): the band needed for the UK, Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, USA and Germany, with university and visa rules separated

### MBA
- [MBA in Europe without GMAT](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/mba-in-europe-without-gmat): the four different things "no GMAT" can mean, which schools accept their own admission test, and which never waive it
- [MBA in Germany without GMAT](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/mba-in-germany-without-gmat): German business schools, waiver rules and costs
- [Best MBA colleges in Australia](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/best-mba-colleges-in-australia): on-campus MBA programmes, rankings and fees
- [Online MBA in Australia](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/online-mba-in-australia): QS 2026 online MBA rankings and fees, and why an online MBA cannot support an Australian student visa or 485 post-study work rights

### Medicine
- [Best medical universities in Australia](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/best-medical-universities-in-australia): entry tests, seat numbers for international students, and fees

### Deciding whether to go
- [IIT or IIM vs study abroad](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/iit-iim-vs-study-abroad): an honest comparison of cost, careers, visas and return on investment
- [Tier-3 college abroad vs tier-1 in India](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/tier-3-college-abroad-vs-tier-1-india): when a low-ranked college abroad is the wrong choice, and the warning signs
- [Benefits of studying abroad](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/benefits-of-studying-abroad)

### Reference
- [Grading system in Canada](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/grading-system-in-canada): the 4.0, 4.3, 12-point and percentage scales, with per-university tables
- [Humanities courses and subjects](https://www.unicoach.com/blogs/top-humanities-courses): what counts as humanities, example classes and career options
